# Calibration of uncertainties (generated by `scripts/calibration.py`)

Pre-registered in [CALIBRATION_PREREGISTRATION.md](CALIBRATION_PREREGISTRATION.md) before any of these numbers were computed. Code version 0.6.0. A scale *k* of 1 means the quoted uncertainties are right; the pre-registered band for "calibrated" is 0.8–1.25.

## 1. Real-star null test (real SPHEREx data, no simulation)

71 still-star tracks in trusted detectors of the six frozen fields (targets excluded); 462 position residuals from tracks with three or more visits.

| Quantity | Measured | If the error model is right |
|---|---|---|
| Position error scale *k* (robust, 1.4826 × MAD) | **0.42** (uncertainties too large (conservative)) | 1.00 |
| Position error scale *k* (RMS, sensitive to outliers) | 1.20 | 1.00 |
| Residuals within 1σ | 91.6 % | 68.3 % |
| Residuals within 2σ | 95.2 % | 95.5 % |
| Still stars with motion significance ≥ 3 (candidate level) | 3 of 71 (4.2 %) | at most 1.1 % |
| Still stars with motion significance ≥ 5 (one detector's share of a confirmation) | 2 of 71 (2.82 %) | at most 0.0004 % |

Tracks per field: barnard 2, epsindib 11, rdra 0, rwaur 19, trappist1 21, wise0855 18.

## 2. Injection pulls (velocity error ÷ quoted uncertainty, confirmed injections)

| Set | Confirmed injections | Rayleigh scale *k* | Within the 68 % radius | Within the 95 % radius |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Development (seed 2026): estimate | 536 | **8.05** (uncertainties too small) | 41.2 % | 56.9 % |
| Held-out A (seed 20261115): check | 350 | **4.80** (uncertainties too small) | 34.6 % | 47.7 % |

Expected if calibrated: *k* = 1.00, 68.3 % and 95.4 %.

## 3. Temperature interval coverage (synthetic spectra on TRAPPIST-1's real SPHEREx bands)

60 spectra per temperature, 237 points each, seed 20261116. The fit always adds an 8 % floor to the quoted errors.

| Noise put into the synthetic spectra | 800 K | 1200 K | 1800 K | 2500 K | 3200 K | Mean coverage | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| measurement errors only | 0 % | 0 % | 100 % | 98 % | 95 % | **59 %** | above 68 % (the floor makes the interval conservative) |
| measurement errors plus the 8 % floor the fit assumes | 0 % | 0 % | 52 % | 40 % | 20 % | **22 %** | ≈ 68 % |
